elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 applies the cap to “each Party's total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap includes fees paid or payable in the twelve months preceding the claim as its fee-based component.
elements.evidence: The cap is based on “the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the twelve-month fee amount and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The clause caps liability solely at twelve months' fees and contains no USD 1,000,000 floor or greater-of formulation.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded for both Parties.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion of indirect damages.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded for both Parties.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no exclusion of consequential damages.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include a Party's “breach of its confidentiality obligations,” and Excluded Claims are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of data protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No data protection carve-out appears in the definition of Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: No security-obligation carve-out appears in the definition of Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's indemnification obligations are uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include “a Party's indemnification obligations,” and Excluded Claims are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include a Party's “gross negligence,” and Excluded Claims are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include a Party's “wilful misconduct,” and Excluded Claims are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Fraud is not included among the Excluded Claims.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property is uncapped.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no carve-out for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are expressly excluded from damages subject to the cap.
elements.evidence: The clause does not state that Customer payment obligations are not damages or otherwise exclude those obligations from the cap.

elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to each Party.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 applies the cap to “each Party's total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The mutual cap equals twelve months' fees.
elements.evidence: The cap equals “the fees paid or payable by the Company under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: Each Party's indemnification obligations are carved out of the cap.
elements.evidence: A Party's indemnification obligations are included in Excluded Claims, which are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's breach of confidentiality obligations is carved out of the cap.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations is included in Excluded Claims, which are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Each Party's liability for gross negligence is carved out of the cap.

elements.evidence: A Party's wilful misconduct is included in Excluded Claims, which are excepted from the cap.

result.reason: The operative clause cleanly implements the complete fallback: a mutual twelve-month-fees cap with uncapped indemnification, confidentiality, gross-negligence, and wilful-misconduct claims. It does not meet the preferred position because it omits the USD 1,000,000 floor, indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, several preferred carve-outs, and the payment-obligations clarification.
